source.section: Summaries: DPIA-PSI-01 — Risk assessment row, S1

data_age.derivation: not stated; no age reduction applied in the stated sum, and the reduction never applies to Art. 9/10 data

special_category.basis: Art. 10 (criminal-offence data): a match links the customer to confirmed fraud

vulnerability.derivation: not listed in the stated sum 3+2+1+1+1 = 8; implied 0

reach.derivation: not listed in the stated sum; implied 0 (adverse action is taken within the bank)

adm.derivation: not listed in the stated sum; analyst review before any action, so not a solely automated decision

floor_conditions.floor_note: Literal reading: floor (i) of PGF-18 Part A §3.4 names 'special-category data', and PGF-10 Part A §4 states that criminal-offence data are not a special category, so the floor is not engaged by Art. 10 data. The alternative reading (Factor B's 'Special Categories' row covers Art. 9 and Art. 10) would engage it. Here the index already reaches Significant, so both readings give the same band (subA_notes A-02).
